notes: Omoda/Jaecoo-only Australian BEV model/version review, checked 14 October 2026. One existing Jaecoo J5 EV EV Summit MY26 version is current; no current Omoda-badged Australian BEV is established.

Two independent brand-only model lists were fully transcribed in brand-model-reconciliation.json: CarExpert combined Omoda Jaecoo list and CarsGuide Jaecoo plus Omoda lists. CarExpert credits JATO on model specifications; CarsGuide credits Glass's Information Services. They are independent publisher/data families, not two whole-market BEV lists.

The existing PublishedModelList schema only accepts australian-new-tier1-bevs and requires publishedAt. These brand-only mixed-powertrain pages cannot truthfully fill that role; CarsGuide also provides no dated list publication field. Therefore publishedLists/listResolutions remain empty here. Do not claim global C1 closure from this targeted evidence.

J5 petrol and SHS-H, J7 petrol and SHS-P (including future Black Edition), J8 petrol/hybrid history and current SHS-P, and Omoda 9 SHS-P are non-BEV exclusions. Each source list difference is recorded in the companion research JSON.

Omoda 4 and 7 are official AU future/interest-only entries; September 2026 reporting places launch in 2027 with local powertrains still unconfirmed. Omoda 4 has an overseas BEV, so do not exclude it merely as non-electric. No current AU exact orderable BEV grade is verified.

Jaecoo J6 is absent from current official Australian navigation/build selection and both independent current lists. Older Australian reporting quotes the manufacturer saying it was not slated locally. A third-party J6 database placeholder does not establish official new Australian supply.

Chery Omoda E5 is a historical Chery model name; current Chery E5 remains a separate Chery catalogue identity. UK Omoda E5/5 EV names and trims are not current Australian Omoda-brand versions. Do not rename Chery, duplicate its E5, or make Chery completeness claims in this packet.

Canonical inherited inventory has zero Omoda/Jaecoo records and zero Omoda/Jaecoo unverifiedLeads; J5 EV is listed in existingFamiliesExcluded because it was already catalogued. Do not manufacture an inventoryResolution for that string. The Chery E5 audit record and historical Chery BX/EX/MY25.5/MY27 research entries remain outside this brand pass.

Current page and brochure identity evidence outweigh mixed year/body/price-guide rows. CarsGuide shows 2025/2027 electric-year rows without a new exact official grade, and CarExpert groups Track/Summit across powertrains. Neither supports another Australian BEV trim or a model-year identity change.

Official navigation labels the J5 EV grade Summit and the model page labels the same grade Jaecoo J5 EV Summit. Summit is a trim alias within the BEV MY26 context, not a new trim or model alias; retain catalogue trim EV Summit.

The 10 October historical evidence file contains two J5 NEW advertisements. They were not freshly verified in this pass and do not support a current stock assertion. The new dated availability evidence should supersede the older observation using current maker order-request evidence with stock unverified; keep the historical source records immutable.
